summary: ERROR TO THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS.
attorneys: Mr. Andreio J. Bell for plaintiff in error., Mr. George O. Ide for defendants in error.

opinions.author: Waite
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Waite

delivered the opinion of the court.

The judgment in this case is affirmed on the authority of Roberts v. Bolles, 101 U. S. 119, which we see no reason for reconsidering. Affirmed.
